areas.label: Minimum hours required for graduation: 120 hours.

courses.title: Introduction to Cultural Analysis: French Identities

groups.label: Literature Courses
groups.note: Two courses at the 300- or 400-level in French and/or Francophone literature

groups.label: Medieval and Early Modern Period course
groups.note: Students must take one course focused on the medieval/early modern period. This course can be used to fulfill the Culture or Literature Courses requirement.

groups.label: Electives
groups.note: Three French courses at the 300- or 400-level in any of the following areas: Language and translation, business, cinema, culture, linguistics, literature, media. Professional education courses. (See Foreign Languages- Curricula Preparatory to Teaching Foreign Languages.)
